messages:
maya: FYI customer reported sudden p99 spike ~6:30 UTC, many requests returning 502s. They saw OOM/allocation failures in model-server logs and large per-tenant KV growth. Raising here to get eng eyes on it.
kevin: On it. Do we have tenant id and a sample request to repro?
maya: Tenant: acme-prod-12. Sanitized example: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' -d '{"model":"redwood-2.1","input":"<customer prompt bundle>"}'`
sam: I saw similar symptoms last month — allocator failing leads to fallback to slower allocator path and stalls p99. Ops-bot, can you pull node mem/kv metrics for the pool serving acme-prod-12?
ops-bot: pool=gpu-9 host=node-07 mem_free=1.2GB mem_total=48GB slab_free=0.4GB kv_entries=12.3M kv_bytes=34.8GB host_load=0.92
kevin: Thanks. Repro plan: run customer trace with our load harness: `python tools/repro/generate_load.py --tenant acme-prod-12 --rate 30 --duration 300 --input-file acme_prompts.json` — that'll exercise their typical mix and should surface OOM/backpressure.
maya: Customer can reproduce reliably and attached sanitized log lines: `alloc: failed to allocate 256MB`, `evicting KV entries`, `compact_slab triggered=0`.
sam: Immediate mitigations we can try now: 1) Route tenant to CPU fallback pool for ~10m (canary route) to drain GPU pressure. 2) Temporarily reduce max_tokens & cap concurrency for acme. 3) Trigger slab compaction on affected GPU hosts: `srun --pool gpu-9 --cmd 'slabctl compact --force'`. 4) Enable per-tenant emergency KV cap.
kevin: Agreed. Longer-term fixes: add per-tenant KV upper bound (e.g., 20GB) + `kv.eviction.strategy=aggressive` for noisy tenants; enable allocator defrag heuristics (`alloc.conf: enable_defrag=true`); and surface eviction metrics to Console. I'll prototype allocator tweak behind a feature flag.
maya: I applied the route change and enforced a temporary 60s concurrency cap for the tenant. Customer reports p99 dropped from ~8s to ~250ms but throughput is reduced. They want an ETA for a permanent solution.
sam: Follow-ups for eng-runtime: - collect KV/heap histograms (tools/diag/kv_hist.sh) from node-07 + node-08, - run reproducer with `ALLOC_TUNE=1` to test defrag behavior, - plan a rolling restart of the few workers after compaction to reclaim slabs. I'll open a GH issue with the traces/metrics.
kevin: I'll prepare a targeted rollout with the allocator tweak + per-tenant cap behind a flag and run canary on a small subset of pools tomorrow EOD. @sam please paste exact diag commands here.
sam: Diag commands: `./diag/kv_dump.sh --tenant acme-prod-12 > acme-kv.json.gz` then `python tools/heatmap/plot_kv_heat.py acme-kv.json.gz` and `curl -s http://node-07:9100/alloc/stats | jq .`
maya: Thanks everyone :thumbsup: I updated the customer and marked this escalated -> high. I'll keep the thread posted with any customer repro logs they send.
